dog.description_text:
Sex: Male

Age: 1 year old

Breed: Hound lab mix

Description: medium/large size dog with blond and white short fur

Health: Spayed/neutered, Vaccinated

Temperament: Good with cats and dogs, playful, anxious at times.

Zippy is searching for a foster or adopter in the NYC/ NJ area who can keep up with his love for life. Having lived happily with multiple cats before, he’s a pro at making new friends, even if he sometimes plays a bit exuberantly! He loved snuggling up with his kitty pals and is open to doggie friends too, given a proper introduction.

In addition to being social, he’s super food-motivated, making him a quick learner who's eager to please! His future family should be ready to help manage his anxieties with his medication and belly rubs. If you’re looking for a cuddly, loyal buddy who’ll bring endless joy, this pup’s ready to meet you!

Learn more on his petfinder page.
dog.name: Zippy
